title: Support additional fields in Cáceres catalogue filings
blocker: The original own-name filing was accepted. Extra text fields pass synthetic upload and signing tests, and read-only procedure discovery now lists the exact fields accepted by the filing command. Public catalogue entries expose authentication choices instead of the Relec controls. Acceptance of a filing with extra text remains unverified.
unblock: Provide a sanitized authenticated Relec form with editable extra fields or identify a holder and a procedure for read-only form inspection. A needed filing using those fields requires separate authorization and a verified receipt.
notes: 2026-11-04: `caceres tramite` implements own-name Relec catalogue filings, one
PDF per slot, required-slot coverage, local PAdES/XAdES and shared receipt
saving. The padrón alta plan opened the live form and mapped three
owner-provided PDFs without uploading or registering. Synthetic tests cover
the confirmation boundary, fixed slot IDs, holder contacts, signatures,
failures and receipts. Live `TramitaSign`/`TramitaJustif` acceptance and the
actual justificante remain unverified. Other procedure-specific fields beyond
Asunto cannot be configured. Next: on a separately owner-authorized filing,
preserve the actual receipt and sanitize the response structure; never
register merely to obtain a trace. 2026-11-04 live acceptance: the
owner-approved padrón alta of [redacted] registered successfully, all three PDFs on the justificante, `caceres registros`
lists it. Still open: procedure fields beyond Asunto.

2026-11-27: Compared the public municipal catalogue detail pages for padrón, personal data changes and the general form with the authenticated Relec route. The public pages did not expose the form controls. The caceres procedimiento result now includes editableFields, selected by the same predicate used by caceres tramite --campos. Synthetic CLI coverage proves that hidden fields and Asunto are excluded and the reader stops after opening the form.
